text:
Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Color-Block Area Rug, 5 x 8 Foot, Multicolor
Materials: Wool
Add interest to your home decor with this eye-catching modern-style rug. With a unique design reminiscent of modern-era abstract art, this rug has bold shapes that extend beyond its edges and rich hues that will add a splash of color to the room. 5' x 8' Pile: 100% wool This richly textured rug uses spaced-dyed yarn in a looped-and-cut technique. The thick pile makes it luxurious, and the hand-tufted construction means it is both soft and durable, perfectly suited to high-traffic indoor areas. The medium 0.3'' pile makes this rug ideal for moderate-traffic areas like bedrooms or sitting rooms Pair with rug pad (sold separately)
